item.title: Affordable housing residents near Portland ICE building ask judge to limit feds’ use of tear gas
item.description: The complex's property manager and multiple residents filed a lawsuit after months of repeated exposure.

item.title: Some US schools cancel class pictures after online claims surrounding Epstein
item.description: Photography giant Lifetouch called the claims “completely false.”

item.title: Judge dismisses charges against 3 Connecticut officers accused of mistreating paralyzed prisoner
item.description: The officers were accused of mistreating a prisoner after he was paralyzed in a police van.

item.title: A California photographer is on a quest to photograph hundreds of native bees
item.description: Krystle Hickman has photographed over 300 types of bees native to North America.

item.title: East Ridge, Faith girls win FHSAA weightlifting state championships
item.description: Multi-sport athletes Molly O'Hara, Amiah Newton and Gia Griffith are girls weightlifting state champions. "I really do feel like all of them make me better,” O'Hara said of playing sports year-round.

item.title: Immigration officials plan to spend $38.3 billion to boost detention capacity to 92,000 beds
item.description: ICE plans 16 regional processing centers with a population of 1,000 to 1,500 detainees.

item.title: FHSAA realigns football districts; Orlando Christian Prep gains 3 opponents
item.description: Orlando Christian Prep gains three new teams in a distrct that was once a two-team district with Father Lopez.

item.title: Ciscar, Sosa lead Hurricanes baseball to season-opening rout
item.description: Starter AJ Ciscar tossed five strong innings, and transfer catcher Alex Sosa hit a three-run home run to lead the Hurricanes to an Opening Night win over Lehigh.

item.title: Orlando high school scores and statistics from Friday, Feb. 13
item.description: Girls hoops region quarterfinal winners included OCP, CFCA, Windermere Prep, Oak Ridge, Edgewater and Colonial. Montverde won its girls soccer regional. Alton Hughes had a home run, double and 5 RBI for DeLand baseball.
